Q436.reason: The employer's own $80,000 property claim can be brought separately, so the clerk's judgment would not impair its interest; the shared-note claim that the employer is indispensable is wrong, since a nonjoined party with a separate claim is not required under Rule 19.

Q434.reason: The signed separate sheet requires modifications to be in writing, so under UCC 2-209(2) the oral price increase is unenforceable; the shared note's claim that shipment makes the oral change binding has no basis in the UCC.

Q441.reason: A nonparty driver's guilty plea is hearsay with no applicable exception in a suit against the lumber company, whereas the insurance and reputation options fit recognized exceptions (ownership/control, agency, or character rebuttal).
